domestic_cat.description: True if at least one domestic cat is visible.

person.description: True if at least one person is visible.

wildlife_felid.description: True if a wild felid is visible (lion, tiger, and similar).

contains_manmade_object.description: True if a built or manufactured object is visible.

stated_confidence.description: Model self-assessment of how sure it is that the four flags are correct (0–1). Not a harness score; gold labels omit this key.
